summary: Auto-track snow-coherent biome seeds + ALPTOWN + one-side sea groundwork
detail: [R8 BIOME item 19 2026-08-30] Seed-level constraint on the biome roll. SYMPTOM (user, seed 777): the route ran INDUSTRIAL / COAST / FOREST / ALPINE / FIELDS / INDUSTRIAL / ORIENTAL / FIELDS -- one 150-span run of snow surrounded by five non-snowy runs, with a palm-lined COAST 300 spans earlier. Every individual transition was legal under the R2 adjacency rules; the defect was at the level of the whole seed. ROOT CAUSE of the lurch, and it was structural rather than a weighting problem: climate 2 (cold) had exactly ONE member, ALPINE, and ALPINE is urbanity 0. Rule 2 caps an urbanity step at 1, so no cold biome could ever follow a cold biome -- the adjacency graph had NO cold-to-cold edge at all, and every snow stretch was forced back out through a temperate biome after at most repeat_max cells. No re-weighting of the picker could have fixed that. FIX, three parts. (1) NEW BIOME ALPTOWN (k_biomes index 7, climate 2 / urbanity 1) -- a snowy town, which also answers the 'snowy themed biomes AND CITIES' half of the request. Being urbanity 1 it is one step from ALPINE, so it is the first legal cold-to-cold edge. Road surface is RS_TARMAC (a ploughed town road), NOT ice, deliberately: with snow now chaining, an icy ALPTOWN would put most of a snow seed on RS_ICE. ALPINE keeps repeat_max 2, so the longest continuous ice run stays 300 spans, the same order as before. It reuses the existing WALL/GROUND pages -- what a snowy town LOOKS like is TERRAIN's and VARIETY's call. (2) TWO-PASS LAYOUT (tg_biome_layout -> tg_biome_layout_pass). Pass 1 is the UNMODIFIED algorithm over the UNMODIFIED modulo-7 draw; it is then asked one question -- does ALPINE appear in the cells the track actually reaches (scanned over spec->target_spans, not over all 22 cells, so an ALPINE nobody can drive to is not a false trigger). If yes, the layout is thrown away and re-laid in snow mode: warm biomes (climate 0, i.e. COAST) struck from the draw, ALPTOWN added, and a cold predecessor prefers a cold successor 80% of the time (a temperate one 60%). Two-pass because the trigger is a property of the SEED and cannot be known at cell 3. (3) ONE-SIDE SEA groundwork: tg_water_side and tg_sea_level_y now key off tg_biome_run_bounds (the MERGED run) instead of the raw 150-span cell, which is the precondition COAST's own table comment named for lifting its repeat_max 1 pin. With COAST still capped at 1 a merged run IS one cell, so that adoption is a provable no-op on every existing seed. MEASURED across 18 seeds, 7 of which roll snow: warm runs 9 -> 0, snowy runs 13 -> 60 of 70, climate changes along a track 31 -> 8. Seed 777 goes from 2/10 snowy with 5 climate changes to 9/10 snowy with 1. KNOBS: TD5RE_R8_BIOME_SNOW default ON (td5_env_flag_on returns 1 when unset, which is the wanted default; =0 restores pre-R8 selection exactly). TD5RE_R8_BIOME_SEA default OFF via td5_env_int with an explicit 0 default -- the cap lift is sound but seed 99991 contains a COAST run, and 99991 is the reference layout the other seven R8 areas quote span numbers against this round. SEED 99991 IS UNCHANGED BY CONSTRUCTION, not by luck: it rolls no ALPINE, so it never enters pass 2, and pass 1 is bit-identical to the pre-R8 code. Accounting slot TG_ACCT_R8_SNOWRUN / 'snow-runs' marks the snowy runs so the race.log element inventory carries the proof the rule fired, and its run list IS the snow layout. CONFIRM BY DRIVING: AUTO-GENERATED track (DefaultTrack=60) with TD5RE_AUTOTRACK_SEED=777 -- the route should read as one cold place end to end (alpine wilderness alternating with snowy towns) instead of stepping through forest, fields and a coast. Then TD5RE_AUTOTRACK_SEED=99991 and confirm its biome runs in race.log still read CITY 0-449 / ORIENTAL / CITY 600-899 / INDUSTRIAL / COAST / ORIENTAL exactly as before. Also try TD5RE_R8_BIOME_SNOW=0 on 777 to see the old lurching layout back. NOT VERIFIED THIS ROUND: whether a mostly-ALPTOWN track is visually varied enough (it reuses the city wall page, so a snowy town currently looks like a generic town); no snow LOOK work was done, that is TERRAIN's item 16. TD5RE_R8_BIOME_SEA has had no drive test at all -- it is groundwork.
